_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits on the Complacency ceiling in a coil where HOLD is the honest default until ETF-flow or momentum actually breaks the band.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is Complacency/HOLD/CAUTION; narrative outflow print plus bottom analog imply accumulation bias without an explicit phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-58 with muted 30d momentum and no ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with momentum that lifts F&G through 62, or a vol/funding flush drops F&G below 46 into Anxiety
